items.description: Tenant has the right to contract for three 10Gig cross connect waves between the two named locations.
items.span_text: Tenant shall have the right to contract for three 10Gig cross connect waves between 2121 S Price Rd. Chandler, AZ 85286 (“A”) and 120 E Van Buren Phoenix, AZ 85004 (“Z”).

items.description: Tenant pays for the cross-connect service at Landlord's contract cost with the provider.
items.span_text: The cost of the service to the Tenant will be at Landlord’s contract cost with provider.

items.description: Tenant and other Tenant Parties may use the Common Area on a nonexclusive basis.
items.span_text: Tenant, and the other Tenant Parties, shall have the nonexclusive right to use the Common Area as constituted from time to time

items.description: Landlord must give Tenant round-the-clock access to the Tenant Space, subject to the Lease terms, access controls and Force Majeure.
items.span_text: Tenant shall have access to the Tenant Space twenty-four (24) hours per day, seven (7) days per week.

items.anchor_event: Landlord receives a Datacenter Expansion Request from Tenant
items.description: Landlord must give written notice on availability of an expansion area within the stated period after receiving a request.
items.span_text: Landlord shall, within fifteen (15) calendar days after Landlord receives a Datacenter Expansion Request from Tenant, give Tenant written notice (“Landlord’s Datacenter Offer”) advising Tenant as to whether a Datacenter Expansion Area is available for lease to Tenant

items.description: Tenant must give written notice to request an expansion area if it wants one.
items.span_text: If Tenant desires to lease a Datacenter Expansion Area, Tenant must give written notice (“Datacenter Expansion Request”) to Landlord
items.trigger: If Tenant desires to lease a Datacenter Expansion Area

items.anchor_event: Tenant receives the Landlord’s Datacenter Offer
items.description: Tenant may exercise its expansion right by giving written notice within the stated period after receiving Landlord's offer.
items.span_text: Tenant may lease the Datacenter Expansion Area offered in Landlord’s Datacenter Offer by giving written notice (“Datacenter Expansion Exercise Notice”) to Landlord on or before the date fifteen (15) calendar days after Tenant receives the Landlord’s Datacenter Offer
items.trigger: If Landlord advises Tenant that a Datacenter Expansion Area is available for lease to Tenant

items.description: Tenant must accept the expansion area in as-is condition.
items.span_text: Tenant shall take the Datacenter Expansion Area in “as-is” condition
